name: Katano (Japan)
description: A blue field charged at the centre with the Katano city emblem in white: a winged device above an outlined pointed loop.
history: Municipal flag of Katano, a city in Osaka Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 12 January 1963.

features.role: Katano city emblem — a winged device above an outlined pointed loop
